title: How to write "haha" in Korean 🎩 #learnkorean
caption:
haha → 하하 (ha·ha)

ㅎ = h — draw a little hat (short line, long line), then a face (circle).
ㅏ = a — a tall line with a short tick to the right.
ㅎ + ㅏ = 하, so haha = 하하 😆

Texting tip: Koreans also type ㅎㅎ for a soft "hehe".

SYNK LAB
#learnkorean #studykorean #hangul #koreanwriting
pinnedComment: Your turn: write 하하 in the comments 👇 (hat → face → ㅏ)
alt: Top-down view of a lined notebook. A pencil writes haha in English and draws an arrow down. A voice says How do you write haha in Korean? Under it the pencil writes the Korean letter ㅎ: a short line and a long line become a little top hat (label hat), then a circle gets laughing eyes and a red smile (label face), then ㅏ, making 하; a second 하 follows. The English letters h a h a drop down under ㅎ and ㅏ. A voice says 하하. The view moves closer: the two letters wear hats and laugh, tip their hats, speech bubbles say 하!, a voice says Now you can laugh in Korean, and the hats fly up, spin and land again.
